census.scientific_scope: Descriptive fixed-evidence D development; 41 seed11 cells, one repository family. No inference, pooling or automatic exclusions.

initial_exposure_limitations: Initial completed-request receipt does not prove semantic use or verification.
Five source-frozen answer-only omission cells are retained; zero-edge tasks are not retargeted.
No later graph API; no distinct stored-graph versus answer-only causal-effect claim.
Historical aborted v1 records are not pooled or substituted.
limitations: Development reporting only; no P/Q confirmation or cross-block pooling.
Issue families, not cells/seeds/wording references, are the independent reporting units.
Observed token counters and overlapping episode durations are not GPU-hours or monetary costs.
No new lifecycle cleanup, container absence or capacity-release proof is established by this report.

D90.repetition: registered inference seeds, equal within issue

T12.issue: selected instance_id; one task per selected family

mapping.costs: Native-authenticated cumulative prompt/completion tokens and calls; inner episode and outer controller wall seconds. Missing is null; unknown usage is not zero. Summed episode durations are not block elapsed time or GPU-hours.
mapping.diagnostics: Executed graph/source-reference tool actions and tokenizer preflights only; no semantic verification or source-read inference from bash.

fixed41.shared_baselines: references only; never copied into the 41 measured rows

mapping.future_confirmation: Separate P/Q freeze required for estimands, clustering/variant/seed weights, primary/secondary family, uncertainty, multiplicity, alpha, missing-data rules and any equivalence margin.

native_producer_contract.unknown_exit: other_or_missing; authenticated source evidence retained, never inferred successful or failed

mapping.rates: Only when every planned cell has an authenticated candidate outcome. Equal cells within issue; equal issues within family; micro_issue and macro_family reported. No CI, p-value or pairwise contrast.
mapping.status: Development reporting specification fixed in source after pilot execution began; not preregistration.
mapping.unknowns: Every planned row remains. Unknown is null, never failure or exclusion. Agent outcome subclasses are retained verbatim from the authenticated safe exporter.

public_outcome_histogram.limitation: The frozen public proof distinguishes unsupported_candidate_nonexecuted from unsupported_encoding_nonexecuted, but does not expose private policy.reason_codes. No protected-path subtype is inferred.
